trigger_cases.prompt: Design a pricing model and tier packaging for a new B2B AI agent platform.
Audit our SaaS pricing page and help us transition from seat-based to usage-based pricing.
Determine the Willingness-to-Pay and Good-Better-Best packaging for our DTC beauty subscription.
We are suffering from heavy sales discounting. Help us build a Pocket Price Waterfall and governance matrix.
How should we price our F2P mobile game battle pass and in-game economy?
Calculate the state sales tax and VAT on this accounting ledger.
Fix the CSS flexbox layout on our checkout modal button.
Write a PostgreSQL migration for user password hashes.

binary_cases.prompt: How should we price our new enterprise workflow automation tool?
binary_cases.pass_rule: The approach anchors price on Economic Value to Customer (EVC) and Next Best Alternative rather than cost-plus or arbitrary competitor copying.
binary_cases.pass_fixture: First quantify the Economic Value to Customer (EVC) and Willingness-to-Pay (WTP) by establishing the Next Best Alternative and positive differentiation value, then target capturing 20-40% of the surplus.
binary_cases.fail_fixture: Calculate our server hosting costs and add a 30% markup to set the price.

binary_cases.prompt: We built an autonomous AI coding agent that completes tasks in seconds. How should we price it?
binary_cases.pass_rule: The recommendation avoids pure seat-based pricing that penalizes efficiency and selects work-units, tasks, or a two-part tariff.
binary_cases.pass_fixture: Avoid pure seat-based pricing because efficiency reduces user headcount. Use an outcome/work-unit model or a two-part tariff (base platform fee plus metered tasks/compute).
binary_cases.fail_fixture: Price per seat at $30/user/month so that larger teams pay more.

binary_cases.prompt: Our enterprise customers keep signing up for our $20/mo starter plan. How do we fix this?
binary_cases.pass_rule: The strategy builds hard feature and governance fences (SSO, audit logs, SLAs, compliance, user limits) that prevent high-WTP buyers from using lower tiers.
must_not: ask enterprise customers nicely to pay more
binary_cases.pass_fixture: Implement strict feature and governance fences such as SAML SSO, SOC2 audit logs, dedicated support SLAs, and usage caps that force enterprise buyers to self-select into the Enterprise tier.
binary_cases.fail_fixture: Leave the features unchanged and add a note asking enterprises to contact sales.

binary_cases.prompt: Our sales team is giving away 40% discounts to close deals. How do we regain margin control?
binary_cases.pass_rule: The solution implements a Pocket Price Waterfall, strict discount authority bands, and mandatory quid-pro-quo concessions.
must_not: let sales reps discount freely without limits
binary_cases.pass_fixture: Implement a Pocket Price Waterfall and a structured discount matrix with tiered approval thresholds, requiring mandatory quid-pro-quo concessions (e.g., annual prepay, multi-year term, logo rights) for any discount above 10%.
binary_cases.fail_fixture: Give sales reps unlimited discount freedom so they can close quarterly numbers at all costs.

binary_cases.prompt: How can we structure pricing for our consumer gaming or micro-transaction app to maximize conversion?
binary_cases.pass_rule: The strategy applies behavioral economics (Thaler mental accounting decoupling, dual-currency abstractions, or loss-aversion framing).
must_not: charge a direct per-click credit card fee for every single action
binary_cases.pass_fixture: Apply mental accounting decoupling using pre-funded virtual currency bundles (gems/credits) to separate the pain of paying from the moment of in-game consumption.
binary_cases.fail_fixture: Charge the user's credit card directly $0.10 for each individual in-game move.
